messages:
Asha: Heads up team — design question: should the autofallback preview create an auditable dry-run event? PM and compliance want tamper-evidence.

Ben: Yes. The preview must emit an immutable dry-run entry that contains the simulation input and decision summary (no PII). Otherwise we lose traceability.

Clara: UX: keep the route card clean. Show 'last dry-run' timestamp and a one-line summary. Deep dive opens the timeline. Preview modal shows a small table and a 'record dry-run' checkbox (checked by default).

Terry: Ops: if dry-run logs are large we need retention policies. Suggest TTL configurable per org, default 30d. Also cap simulation payload at 2kb.

Asha: Quick sketch for recorded summary (example shown in modal):

```text
route: payments.capture
template: prod-strict
previewed_decisions: 23
sampled_reasons: [HIGH_LATENCY_P95, MODEL_OVERLOAD]
est_fallback_impact: 8% traffic
```

Ben: API call idea: POST /routes/{id}/fallback/preview -> returns job_id. GET /jobs/{id}/result returns anonymized events and impact score. POST should accept "record=true|false".

Clara: If record=true the UI must show that this will create an audit event that cannot be edited. Add a confirmation step for orgs with 'require_approval' flag.

Terry: infra-bot: any concerns about sim load?

infra-bot: Large sims can be expensive. We'll offer two modes: fast-approx (aggregates) and exact (sampled traces). Queue exact sims and run approximate inline.

Asha: Good. Also add a demo-only "staging dry-run" that tags events as non-compliant so they don't count for official audit but are useful for devs.

Ben: Telemetry: recorded dry-run should include decision_id, template_id, trigger_snapshot (small map), and a short reason_code enum. Keep it <2kb.

Clara: UX follow-ups: add tooltip explaining reason codes and a link to docs. Also surface "likely overloaded pools" if the fallback target is a constrained dedicated pool.

Asha: Next steps: Ben will draft the API shape, Terry will prototype capacity scoring, Clara will make a micro-mock for the preview modal. We'll reconvene after drafts.

Terry: I'll also propose default TTL and storage quota in infra RFC.

Asha: Thanks — if no objections I'll open a short RFC tomorrow.
